newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa hardly moved in PM as interest wanes.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa hardly moved in PM as interest wanes.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa futures were hardly moved in sluggish afternoon trade and prices ended with slight gains amid continued poor industry and speculative interest.
By the close, most-active December was three stg higher at 982 stg a tonne after trading at a narrow nine stg band.
Traders said cocoa was finding very little incentives to move out of the immediate 980-1,000 stg range. Volume was a light 3,319 lots, mostly dominated by switches and AAs.
As in the past few sessions, outright dealings were capped by a dearth of fundamental and technical factors.
"The trouble is there's no industry interest, the origins are lightly in the market," said one trader. "There's quite a few AAs today, so at least gets the volume up," he said.
The New York cocoa futures market also saw waning participation especially from speculators.

On the charts, technical analysts said London cocoa was likely to tread water in the short term, with support seen at 969 stg and upside target at 1,000. -- Jalil Hamid, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4985
